title: LEGITIMO
style: Phonk at 137 BPM with distorted 808 slides, punchy kick, chopped cowbell, lo-fi vinyl crackle, murky dark pads, clipped drums, saturated mids, and a gritty underground mono mix. Orquesta beat brass hits, trombone stabs, string accents, tiled-bathroom reverb, slapback, flute and violin motifs, hard old-school hip hop trap edge, bold trompetas, beat solo, stark silence break, and techno house percussion with a driving four-on-the-floor pulse. Intense jazz/no background vocals.
